# fw skills

> Reference of the fw skills command: List, read and install SKILL.md skills. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/skills/

List, read and install SKILL.md skills

## Usage

```bash
fw skills <list|read|install>
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw skills list
fw skills read
fw skills install
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
